content.title: Man's Last Duty
about: Man's Last Duty is a short sci-fi puzzle experience built around a strict 60-second loop.
You play as a scientist pressured to complete a set of tests for MLD Corporation. You will fail repeatedly, but you can rewind time and use each attempt to optimize your route and decisions.
Created by SouthWest Studio during the CITM Game Jam 2025 (1 week).
features: Interact and grab system for solving short tasks
Minigame-style challenges inside a single run
In-game notes UI to track information between attempts
learnings: Designing a time-loop structure that encourages iteration
Keeping UI and objectives readable under short time constraints
Coordinating feature work across a small jam team
